console.heading: Console Output
console.description: Log messages printed to the developer console

file.heading: File Output
file.description: Log messages written to a file on disk

lowStock.label: Low-stock warning threshold
lowStock.hint: Warn when a tracked map material's count drops to this number or below. Default 0 warns only when you run out.

pauseInTown.label: Pause Total timer in town
pauseInTown.hint: When enabled, the Total timer freezes while you're in town so the FE/h rate reflects in-map farming throughput. Map and Seasonal trackers are unaffected. Saved sessions still record full wall-clock time.

eventFeed.label: Show live event feed on dashboard
eventFeed.hint: Adds a real-time log of drops, zone changes and tracker events below the item breakdown.

auctionTax.label: Apply auction house tax to values
auctionTax.hint: Reduces every displayed FE value by 15% to reflect the auction house cut. Fuel is exempt — it trades on the material exchange. Affects the dashboard, overlay, sessions and wealth chart, including past sessions.

lootTimers.heading: Seasonal Loot Windows
lootTimers.hint: How long after a seasonal mechanic ends to keep crediting drops to its tracker. Each pickup refreshes the window. Set per mechanic (in seconds).

overrealm.label: Overrealm
overrealm.hint: Time after exiting Overrealm to keep attributing drops to the Overrealm tracker. The reward chest spawn animation needs a few seconds — extend if you find drops landing in the next map instead.

carjack.label: Carjack
carjack.hint: How long the Carjack tracker keeps running with no combat activity. Each kill or spawn restarts it; loot pickups do not. The tracker pauses on expiry and resumes if the fight picks back up, so an encounter you walk away from stops crediting drops without waiting for the game's end music.

clockwork.label: Clockwork Ballet
clockwork.hint: Time after the Clockwork voucher turn-in to keep attributing drops. Cogwheel fights use a fixed 10s timeout and never credit loot, so this only covers the reward burst. That burst can arrive up to 6.7s after the turn-in — set this to 7s or more so a doubled reward is not missed.

lunaria.label: Lunaria
lunaria.hint: Time after the Lunaria encounter ends to keep attributing drops. The tracker pauses on expiry and resumes on the next strum, so this window only needs to cover the post-combat loot of one episode.

sandlord.label: Sandlord wave timer
sandlord.hint: How long the in-map Sandlord tile tracker keeps running after a wave spawns. Each new wave restarts it, as does a machine finishing, so its last drops still count; loot pickups do not. Once the last machine finishes and nothing follows, the run ends when this window runs out.

hunting.label: Hunting
hunting.hint: Loot collection window after the Hunting boss dies.

afterlight.label: Afterlight wave timer
afterlight.hint: How long the Afterlight tracker keeps running with no new mobs. Each wave restarts it; loot pickups do not. The tracker pauses on expiry and resumes on the next wave, so a long lull never splits one encounter in two. After the warden dies this becomes the loot collection window.

overlay.heading: Overlay Window
overlay.opacityHint: Controls how transparent the overlay background appears

clickThrough.label: Click-through tracker while running
clickThrough.hint: When enabled, clicks pass through the overlay during an active session so you can interact with the game underneath. Pause or stop to interact with the tracker.

logPath.heading: Game Log Path
logPath.label: Torchlight Infinite Folder
logPath.hint: Select the root installation folder. The tracker will look for TorchLight\Saved\Logs\UE_game.log inside it.

itemImport.heading: Item Data
itemImport.label: Import item prices from a full_table.json file. Existing items are kept as-is.
itemImport.noneNew: No new items — all were already present.

wealthReset.heading: Farming History
wealthReset.label: Clear all wealth chart data, saved sessions, and per-map breakdowns. This cannot be undone.
wealthReset.confirm: Are you sure? This will permanently delete all wealth chart data, saved sessions, and per-map breakdowns.

serperApiKey.label: Serper API Key
serperApiKey.hint: Used for item name lookup via serper.dev (max 10/day, 2500 free/month). Get a free key at serper.dev.
